title: Sobolev inequality for ζχ_G with a Gauss-Green pair (Simon p. 83; parent Step 7 (S), errata E5 and E6)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, N := n + 1 and p := (n + 1)/n ∈ [1, ∞] (computed in ℝ≥0∞, so p = ∞ when n = 0). There is c > 0 such that for every open U ⊆ ℝ^N, every Lebesgue null-measurable G ⊆ ℝ^N, every Gauss-Green pair (μ, ν) for (U, G) and every K-Lipschitz ζ : ℝ^N → ℝ (K ∈ ℝ≥0) with ζ ≥ 0, compact support and tsupport ζ ⊆ U: eLpNorm(χ_G ζ, p, L^N) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(c (∫ ζ dμ + ∫_G |Dζ| dL^N)), where χ_G ζ = G.indicator ζ, eLpNorm(·, ∞) is the essential supremum, and |Dζ(y)| = ‖fderiv ℝ ζ y‖.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (U G : Set (Rn (n + 1))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + 1))) (ν : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet G volume → IsGaussGreenPair U G μ ν → ∀ (ζ : Rn (n + 1) → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → (∀ y, 0 ≤ ζ y) → eLpNorm (G.indicator ζ) ((n + 1 : ℝ≥0∞) / n) volume ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (∫ y, ζ y ∂μ + ∫ y in G, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ y‖))
